title: Transport Tycoon inspired game set in Japan, made for the AI Gamejam
author: lemonlemons
selftext:
I created a Transport Tycoon inspired game set in Japan. It covers 70 decades with evolving buildings and scenery, and trains, cars and aircraft inspired by authentic vehicles from each era it covers.

  
If anyone wants to try it out, Windows build is available for free at [https://itch.io/jam/2026-epic-ai-megajam/rate/5369577](https://itch.io/jam/2026-epic-ai-megajam/rate/5369577)

comments.author: lemonlemons
comments.body: I added the tools I used into the post. Happy to answer any questions anyone might have as well!

comments.author: Affectionate_Tooth82
comments.body: how long it tooks to get this build? and what is your 3d modelling workflow? the building and art style is amazing, so lovely!

replies.author: lemonlemons
replies.body:
It took around 3 days.   


For 3d, I just tell Claude what I want and Claude uses Blender to model it. I also tell Claude to use judge subagents and iterate until the judge subagents are happy.

replies.author: Affectionate_Tooth82
replies.body: It looks really polished for just 3 days…does it take long for game balance and mechanics design ?

replies.author: lemonlemons
replies.body:
The polish is Claude Fable 5.2 consuming a lot of tokens (100% of Ultra weekly usage overnight) while iterating with subagents :)

As for balance and mechanics, due to limited testing, there may be some issues. But I have played quite a bit and at least the basics seem to work well already.

And even though there is quite a lot of stuff, there's a lot I had to leave out. First person mode (I'd like to make it possible to drive the routes from first person perspective as a passenger or driver), online multiplayer and many other features didn't make it to the jam. But I may implement them later unless my tokens are needed elsewhere.
